Enjoy The Evergreen Kannada Melody “Kallina Veeneya” From The Classic Kannada Movie Guri, Starring Dr. Rajkumar And Archana. Featuring The Timeless Music Of The Legendary Duo Rajan-Nagendra, This Beautiful Song Brings Back The Golden Memories Of Kannada Cinema.
Sing Along With The Lyrics And Enjoy This Unforgettable Classic Kannada Melody.
Kannada Old Songs, Lyrical Songs, Evergreen Melodies, And Classic Sandalwood Hits.
